title: Software Engineer
description: A software engineer applies mathematical analysis and the principles of computer science in order to design and develop computer software.
educationPath: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or practical experience via bootcamps.
futureScope: Extremely high demand as technology continues to integrate into every industry.
roadmap: Get an entry-level software developer row
Progress to Senior Engineer or Architect

title: Data Scientist
description: Data scientists utilize their analytical, statistical, and programming skills to collect, analyze, and interpret large data sets.
educationPath: Master's or Ph.D. in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science or related field.
futureScope: Rapid growth expected with the rise of AI and big data analytics.
roadmap: Transition into a Data Scientist role

title: General Practitioner
description: A medical doctor who treats acute and chronic illnesses and provides preventive care and health education to patients.
educationPath: Medical degree (M.D. or D.O.) followed by a residency program.
futureScope: Steady and perennial high demand due to an aging population.
roadmap: Pass the MCAT and attend Medical School

title: Financial Analyst
description: Financial analysts guide businesses and individuals in making investment decisions by assessing the performance of stocks, bonds, and other types of investments.
educationPath: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration.
futureScope: Stable growth as companies constantly need financial guidance and optimization.
roadmap: Earn a degree in Finance or Economics
Work as a Junior Financial Analyst
Promote to Senior Financial Analyst or Portfolio Manager

title: UX Researcher
description: UX Researchers systematically study target users to collect and analyze data that will help inform the product design process.
educationPath: Degree in HCI, Psychology, Design, or equivalent practical experience.
futureScope: High demand as companies prioritize user-centric design in digital products.
roadmap: Build a research portfolio with case studies
Work as a Junior UX Researcher
